messages:
Priya K: kicking off obs wiring QA for the new eu4 GPU cluster. goal: logs/metrics/traces + basic dashboards + 3 alert templates. handoff to oncall when smoke passes.
Diego M: sweet — which collectors are we using? fluentd or vectord? any egress needs?
Priya K: vectord as primary, fallback fluentd. need outbound to logs.redwood-internal.net:443 and OTLP endpoints on telemetry.redwood.svc:4317 inside the VPC.
Ava L: noted. I have a quick list of validation steps i'll run, posting here: 1) verify vectord config applied 2) confirm logs reach logstore (last-5m) 3) metrics scraping on node-exporter 4) traces visible in tempo 5) import gpu dashboard
Samir: also check flow logs + NAT gateway throughput — last time we hit nat throttling during model pulls. suggest we add a transient NAT LB for the initial load.
Nadia P: cost flag: enable per-service egress metrics so we can tag cost to cluster:aws_account=eu4-gpu. please add a cheap dashboard panel for egress bytes by service.
Ava L: running vectord apply now. config snippet for env Looks like: 
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
      http: {}
exporters:
  otlp/secure:
    endpoint: telemetry.redwood.svc:4317
    tls:
      insecure: false
service:
  pipelines:
    logs:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [otlp/secure]
```
Ava L: pushed config, rolling restart on vectord daemonset. infrabot will post rollout.
InfraBot: vectord-daemonset roll started (ds/vectord-eu4) — 3 nodes -> rollout 3/3.
InfraBot: smoke-check: logs ingestion test -> OK (ingest.latency=120ms, sample=20).
Diego M: can you paste the test log id? I want to grep downstream when I check retention pipeline.
Ava L: test log id: logs-eu4-smoke-20260318-01. grep shows indexed in logstore within 25s.
Samir: node-exporter metrics scraped by prometheus-eu4: up=1 for all gpu nodes. but note: kubelet metrics show container_fs_usage_bytes rising on /var/lib/docker on node-gpu-03 -> 92%
Priya K: put disk-pressure alert in place if node > 90% for 5m. add runbook link.
Ava L: alert rule posted in prometheus-alerts.yaml: 
```yaml
- alert: NodeDiskFillingFast_EU4
  expr: (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/var/lib/docker"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/var/lib/docker"}) < 0.10
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "EU4 GPU node disk >90% on {{ $labels.instance }}"
    runbook: "https://wiki.redwood/infra/runbooks/disk-pressure"
```
Nadia P: good. also add an alert for OTLP exporter error rate > 1% over 1m so we catch config regressions before traces drop.
Ava L: added OTLP exporter error alert. posting Grafana dashboard import ID for GPU overview: dash-eu4-gpu-2026-03 -> import successful.
InfraBot: grafana-import job completed (dash-eu4-gpu-2026-03) -> panels: gpu-util, gpu-mem, pod-latency, egress-by-service.
Diego M: can someone confirm that log retention policy for this cluster is 30d default? and that large-model pull logs are routed to archive bucket?
Priya K: retention=30d yes. archive routing for model pull logs is enabled via label model-pull=true -> s3://redwood-eu4-archive. I will run a quick replay test to ensure object lifecycle is correct.
Samir: one more networking snag we found: private link to metrics backend needed an SG rule for the prometheus scraping subnet. I've opened a small PR to add the SG ingress for 10.200.0.0/20 -> prometheus-eu4.
Ava L: ran the replay: sample model pull logs archived, object visible in s3 path within 90s. retention/ingest validated.
Diego M: packaging a short handoff note for oncall: list of open items (disk-03 at 92% -> cleanup scheduled; NAT LB transient; confirm SG rule merged). then we can mark handoff ready.
Priya K: thanks — i'll post the handoff checklist to PagerDuty escalation channel and tag oncall. handing off in 15.
InfraBot: smoke suite final: all checks green except disk-03 warning. overall status: READY_FOR_ONCALL_HANDOFF.
Nadia P: tagging finance to watch egress next 48h. cc @diego for dashboard share.
Diego M: oncall pinged. will follow up if alerts fire. nice work team :thumbsup:
Priya K: closing thread, moving to runbook state: staged -> prod-rollover. link to artifacts: https://internal.redwood/infra/eu4/telemetry/artifacts
